description: We are the Computer Coolers. We’re an ambitious team of five competing to win. We build fast, make decisions quickly and ship polished work. Our strengths are product-building experience, React and front-end development, and AI-assisted development that takes us from concept to working prototype quickly. We know how to scope a project, cut what doesn’t matter and deliver a demo that’s ready before the deadline. Our team is full, but we’re here to compete seriously and bring our best work.
